run_spm_decode_pieces: run the script to decode sentencepiece pieces from an input file using a sentencepiece model
run_spm_decode_ids: run the script to decode sentencepiece token IDs from an input file using a sentencepiece model
review_main: review the main function that parses arguments and decodes sentencepiece tokens from a file
review_decode_pieces: review the decode function that uses SentencePieceProcessor DecodePieces to reconstruct text from pieces
review_tok2int: review the tok2int helper that remaps unknown tokens represented as <<unk>> to integer 0
